parameters.content:
## 🤖 AI AGENT CONSTELLATION
Two native LangChain agents share one self-hosted Ollama brain and reach into the live VYREX API as callable tools. Chat with either from the n8n "Chat" panel.

One-time setup: create an Ollama credential named exactly `VYREX Ollama` (Base URL http://ollama:11434).

options.systemMessage: You are the VYREX Triage Analyst, an air-gapped SOC assistant. Use your tools to pull the ranked finding queue, explain individual findings (SHAP), check compliance posture, review correlated fusion clusters, and check threat-intel sightings. Prioritise by exploitability (KEV/EPSS), multi-tool consensus, and asset exposure. Always cite concrete finding ids and scores. Be concise.

parameters.toolDescription: Get the current ranked queue of top open findings (severity, risk score, KEV, EPSS, consensus, ATT&CK technique, asset). Use this first.
Get the explainable SHAP breakdown for ONE finding by its numeric id — why it scored the way it did.
Get findings that multiple independent tools (scanner + agent + intel) corroborated on the same asset — the highest-confidence signal.
Get recent threat-intel sightings (MISP IOC matches / OpenCTI ATT&CK correlations) observed in the environment.
Get the current compliance posture summary (pass/fail counts by control framework).

options.systemMessage: You are the VYREX Response Commander, an air-gapped SOC assistant. Use your tools to investigate incidents, correlate findings into new incidents, dispatch pending alerts, run response playbooks, and check platform health. You may PROPOSE containment, but never claim to have executed any destructive action — containment requires two-person approval in VYREX. Be concise and cite evidence.

parameters.toolDescription: Run the VYREX investigation agent on an incident by its numeric id — returns a narrative, timeline and ATT&CK kill-chain.
Correlate high-risk open findings above a minimum score into incidents (dedupes automatically). Use a min_score around 50-70.

values.name: min_score
values.description: minimum risk score 0-100 to correlate on

parameters.toolDescription: Route VYREX's unacknowledged alerts to the configured channels (idempotent). Call when asked to notify or escalate.
Run a named VYREX response playbook by its id (e.g. pb-n8n-automation).
Check whether the VYREX platform (Postgres, OpenSearch, NATS) is fully ready.

parameters.content:
## ⏱ Auto-Triage Loop — every 15 min
Pull the ranked queue → correlate high-risk findings → route pending alerts. The unattended tier-1 analyst.

## 🚨 Critical Responder — webhook /vyrex
Fired by VYREX's own playbook `pb-n8n-automation` on high/critical findings. Correlates + dispatches, then acks the caller.

## 📥 Alert Intake — webhook /vyrex-alert
Every VYREX alert-channel delivery lands here: critical ones escalate, and every one is emailed (Mailpit) + posted to chat.

parameters.subject: =VYREX alert — {{ $json.body.subject || 'notification' }}

parameters.content:
## ⏰ SLA-breach Escalation — hourly
Counts incidents past their SLA due time; if any, escalates alerts and cuts an executive report.

parameters.jsCode:
const breached = $input.all().filter(i => i.json && i.json.sla_breached === true);
return [{ json: { breached: breached.length, incidents: breached.map(b => ({ id: b.json.id, title: b.json.title, severity: b.json.severity })) } }];

parameters.content:
## 🎯 IOC Responder — every 20 min
Scans the ranked queue for findings with live threat-intel context and a meaningful score; correlates and dispatches.

parameters.jsCode:
const hits = $input.all().filter(i => i.json && i.json.threat_intel && Number(i.json.risk_score) >= 60);
return [{ json: { count: hits.length, indicators: hits.map(h => ({ id: h.json.id, cve: h.json.cve_id, ioc: h.json.threat_intel, score: h.json.risk_score })) } }];

parameters.content:
## 📊 Daily Posture Report — 08:00 UTC
Generates the daily posture report and routes any pending alerts.

## 🧠 AI Analyst Triage (governed) — every 30 min
The VYREX-hosted, deterministic Ollama triage pass (distinct from the chat agents above — no tool-calling, one governed JSON decision per finding).

## ✅ Compliance Drift Watch — every 6 hours
Watches the compliance pass-rate; if it drops below 70%, cuts a compliance report and dispatches.

Verifies the response-action audit hash chain is unbroken; dispatches a tamper alert if not.

## 💓 Platform Health Watchdog — every 5 min
Polls readiness (Postgres/OpenSearch/NATS); dispatches if the platform degrades.

Summarizes multi-tool-corroborated findings and posts a digest to chat.

meta.description: The single consolidated VYREX automation graph: a two-agent native LangChain constellation (shared Ollama brain, 10 tools reaching into the live VYREX API) sitting above 12 deterministic lanes covering triage, critical/alert/IOC webhooks, SLA escalation, daily posture, governed AI triage, compliance drift, audit-chain integrity, health watchdog and fusion digest. Replaces vyrex-complete-automation.json / vyrex-all-in-one.json / vyrex-soc-agent.json / 01-07 as the one workflow to import and activate.
